That trajectory is what this fan buys, on the side (electron) that reaches the design densities — the hole side of the D = 0 line ends at −1.27×10¹² inside the validators, in the near-CNP balanced-pair exception regime.

**Design (computed, landau-fan step 1).** Per-column SdH-FFT fan → slow axis **uniform in 1/B**: Δ(1/B) = 1/(3 × 34 T) = 0.0098 T⁻¹ (3 rows/period on F_L at n = 3.25 nominal, ≥ 2.6 on a region-B sum tone up to 34 T; Nyquist 51 T, so the 45 T heavy-tone 2nd harmonic does not alias) → **134 rows, 0.7 → 8 T**. Partner-tone record at the low-n edge (scale 0.91): 2.8 periods at n = 1.0, 4.2 at 1.5, 5.6 at 2.0 → the ≥ 5-period partner claim holds for n ≳ 1.9×10¹²; below that the columns read the trajectory, not a resolved partner. δF = 0.77 T on the full 0.7–8 T record. Dwell 1.2 s = 4τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct, asserted in the cell): the fast-axis lag is a uniform ≈ 1-column shift in n (1–3 %, inside the lever-arm prior), and the SdH phase step between adjacent columns is ≤ 0.15 cycle where the heavy tone is alive (≥ 1.4 T), so the mixing attenuates amplitude ≤ 11 % without moving frequencies; 6τ would add 1.7 h.
